note: rule (b) rejected the null but the best winner's Amendment 18 profitability bound is not above zero. max_of_m is max_of_n with the campaign as the unit, and that is deliberate rather than lazy: section 4 of the pre-registration chooses it over a Holm budget because it uses the actual null distribution of the maximum, and says the L2 gate INHERITS the family-wise error rate measured for that machinery (0.060, CI [0.041, 0.088] at R = 150, Task 38) rather than needing its own calibration study. A second implementation of the same simulation would be a second thing to calibrate.

standardised_view.note: diagnostic unless statistic='standardised' set the verdict. The maximum over (observed - null mean) / null sd per campaign, which is the pivotal form step_down_max already assumes. Task 70 measured the raw maximum as valid but blind: on our six real validation nulls, whose sds differ by 20x, it named two of the six campaigns the best of M zero times in 4,000 families and a third of them once, and it rejected at 0.0505 against an eight-sigma planted effect in a tight-null campaign where the standardised maximum rejected at 1.0000.
